thread_text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PD ALERT - service=inference-serving-prod region=eu-west-1 severity=high. Rule=5xx_rate_threshold. Incident INC-4821. Page fired to oncall.

ops-oncall: pagerbot noted. I'm the current oncall and will watch the thread.

sam: acked and on it. joining bridge now. sending short status updates here.

pagerbot: Ack recorded: sam.

linh: hey sam — what's the initial symptom? dashboards show a request surge or backend errors?

sam: quick triage: 5xxs are coming from model-backend pods. NGINX upstream 502/504 traces + logs show repeated `context deadline exceeded` and some `kv cache init failed` entries. Not a pure traffic spike.

devon: confirming logs from model-serve-1: `ERROR inference: request handler: upstream reset by peer` - looks like a backend process crash loop on certain GPU nodes.

sam: running `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-serve --since=5m | grep -E "5..|panic|segfault|deadline"` — seeing spikes around container restarts.

sam: plan (quick): 1) divert new traffic off the suspect nodepool (evict pods). 2) scale replicas up on healthy pool with quantized model variant as temporary fallback. 3) restart model-backend with increased probe timeouts. executing step 1 now.

linh: +1. if we can route to a smaller but stable model variant, we can restore customers fast. please post the exact routing command when you make the change.

devon: making an immediate route change to `model-v1-quant` on the traffic router. Command:```bash
# update traffic split
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/splits -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' -d '{"service":"inference","from":"model-v2-canary","to":"model-v1-quant","percent":100}'
```

sam: executing scale & restart:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-serve --replicas=12
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/model-serve
```

pagerbot: Escalation check: no PD auto-escalate yet. Current ack=sam.

anna-cs: CS note — we have two customers reporting timeouts in EU region (ticket CS-614 & CS-617). Customer-facing status page flagged: "degraded performance, retrying requests." I'm sending a short note to impacted accounts.

sam: scaled replicas to 12, routing switched to model-v1-quant. Early metrics: 5xx rate dropping from 5.2% -> 0.8% over the last 2 minutes, p50 latency declining.

linh: monitoring logs and tailing metrics. GPU node that had restarts shows OOMs around same timestamps — suspect memory leak on v2 model.

devon: opening a follow-up issue to pin v2 model and run a canary with more memory headroom. For now, keep traffic on v1-quant.

ops-oncall: thanks for the quick reroute. Are we comfortable with a handoff in ~20 mins if stable? I can stand down and let lin h take the next watch.

sam: yes — I'll annotate the incident with steps taken and handoff notes. Handoff to linh at 16:20Z unless anything regresses.

linh: taking ownership at 16:20Z. I'll do a 30min quiet window + verify customer tickets. Adding `incident:INC-4821` label and creating a monitoring watch.

sam: handoff notes: root cause suspected memory leak in model-v2 on specific GPU driver combo. Mitigations applied: traffic -> model-v1-quant; replicas scaled; restarted model-backend with probe timeout + backoff. Follow-ups: perf regression test v2 under high concurrent load, increase OOM guard, schedule a canary with lower concurrency.

anna-cs: updated customers that we've routed traffic to a stable variant and are investigating root cause. CS will keep customers notified on progress.

linh: monitoring 10m more — so far stable, 5xxs at ~0.2%. setting a 60m post-incident watch.

sam: adding quick logs snippet for postmortem:```text
2024-08-11T16:04:12Z model-serve[pid=3245]: ERROR runtime: alloc failure, attempted=1.2G
2024-08-11T16:04:12Z kubelet: kubelet evicting pod model-serve-2 due to OOM
```

devon: note to infra: that GPU node had recent driver update at 2024-08-10T02:00Z. correlating driver update with rollout of model-v2. Worth checking.

pagerbot: Incident INC-4821 | status=stabilized | acked_by=sam | owner=linh | auto-close in 30m if metrics remain stable. :white_check_mark:

linh: I'm on watch and will ping here every 15m. If anything pops, I'll escalate back to ops-oncall.

sam: thanks team. I'll start the follow-up ticket for the model team and attach logs. handing over complete. :thumbsup:
